steps.name: Step 1 — Create pipeline with state variable user_info (String) — verify via STATE panel
Step 2 — Add two nodes: LLM node (sets user_info) -> Code node -> END, connected by a real edge (not two independent -> END edges)
Step 3 — Code node Input combobox includes user_info
Step 4 — Code node script reads elitea_state.get('user_info', ...) and ends with a bare dict-literal expression, NOT a plain assignment (CLARIFICATION, EliteaAI/elitea-testing-public#1383)
Step 5 — Code node Output is set to state variable code_output
Step 6 — Structured output switch is enabled on the Code node
Step 7 — Execute the pipeline via the embedded chat
Step 8 — Open Run Details, select the Code node timeline step
